g.text: Team (SET) of 2 NICs and Trunk port
Multiple Compute logical networks with different
VLAN IDs can be configured for VM, AKS Cluster or
Single VLAN for the Management network
Storage Intent uses 6 x separate layer 2 networks, with no
default gateway configured on the ethernet interface
Management and Compute Intent requires minimum 2
ports, with one connected to each switch
Storage traffic has two (dual) links for redundancy
